name: Moonpetal Lily
summary: Around Teldrassil’s freshwater pools, Moonpetal Lilies offer petals prized for their restorative power. Healers use them in remedies and healing draughts.

sections.title: Flora of the Pools
sections.body: Moonpetal Lilies grow along the moist banks of freshwater pools and ponds. They are common northwest of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Like other plants atop the young World Tree, they draw on the essence of Teldrassil’s sheltered groves. Their broad petals shine beside the water, where the moisture lets them thrive.

sections.title: Natural Antidotes
sections.body: Night elf healers and herbalists prize Moonpetal Lilies for their healing properties. Mixed with forest plants such as Hyacinth Mushrooms, the lilies help soothe and stabilize. Healers brew antidotes from them for deadly toxins, including the venom of Webwood spiders in Shadowthread Cave.

faq.answer: Moonpetal Lilies grow along the banks of two freshwater ponds northwest of Aldrassil in Shadowglen, on Teldrassil.

faq.q: What are Moonpetal Lilies used for?
faq.answer: Moonpetal Lilies have restorative and healing properties. In Shadowglen, Dirania Silvershine combines them with Hyacinth Mushrooms and Webwood Ichor to brew an antidote for spider venom.

faq.q: Who needs an antidote made from these lilies?
faq.answer: Iverron is a night elf bitten by Webwood spiders near Shadowthread Cave. He needs an antidote made with Moonpetal Lilies to survive.

faq.q: Can Moonpetal Lilies be gathered outside of Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Moonpetal Lilies grow around Teldrassil’s secluded pools. They are known in Shadowglen’s sheltered boughs.

angles.text: In urgent crises, healers gather Moonpetal Lilies by hand. The flowers show the restorative power of Teldrassil’s plants.
As a young kaldorei training in Shadowglen, you learn how native plants like Moonpetal Lily can heal. It is an early lesson in living with nature.
